name: WafTuning
title: Templates/Platform/View/WafTuning
summary: The Tuning tab of a WAF rule set: the requests it matched, grouped by rule, so the user can allow the legitimate ones. A `PageHeader` with Export to CSV and an allow action that reads Allow n selected once rows are checked; threshold settings above the table (a Time range `Select`, a Minimum hits `Input` that validates as a whole number, a search `Input` and a Refresh `IconButton`); and a flush `Card` with a data-driven `TableRoot` with row selection and sorting (Rule ID, Threat, Hits sorted high to low, and the top IP addresses, countries and paths, two shown and a `Tag` counting the rest). Rows below the minimum hits drop out, and a table with none left shows a small `EmptyState` saying how to widen it. Allowing opens a `Dialog` form listing the selected rules and how many allowed rules will be created (one per rule and path), with a required Reason `Textarea` whose error shows only after Allow rules is pressed; success closes it, clears the selection and raises a success toast, failure keeps it open with a danger `Alert` and Try again. Built from `PageHeader`, `Button`, `Field`, `Select`, `Input`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Card`, `TableRoot`, `Tag`, `EmptyState`, `Dialog` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Alert`, `Textarea`; its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Allow
variants.summary: Two rules checked and the Allow 2 rules dialog open: rule 1005 (SQL injection on 3 paths) and 1201 (Cross-site scripting on 3 paths), 6 allowed rules in all, and an empty Reason.

variants.name: AllowFailed
variants.summary: The same dialog after the allowed rules could not be created: a danger Alert says nothing changed in the rule set, and the submit button reads Try again.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A rule set that has not matched any request: no threshold settings, and an EmptyState saying matches appear as traffic arrives.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the matches load: the settings and actions are disabled and the table shows skeleton rows.
